annotations.title: Start a company's DIYA-GL book from Companies House

description: Starts the DIYA-GL book of a limited company's next accounting period from the Companies House register: the company, its registered office, its current directors and secretaries, and the roll forward of its last filed accounts when the register holds them as iXBRL, so the opening balance sheet equals the filed closing one. With a codesEntryId it also writes in the statement of capital and the shareholders. Saves it in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account as a new book, which becomes the open one. Use this when the person starts a company's records for its next year from what Companies House holds. It does not change another DIYA-GL book or file anything.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to keep the DIYA-GL book in that client's set

codesEntryId.description: An entry request_companies_house_codes answered (kind confirmation-statement-data), to add the capital and the shareholders

madeUpDate.description: The date the shareholdings are read as at, YYYY-MM-DD; today by default

periodEnd.description: The year end chosen, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the register's next period end

name: new_book_from_register
